column1: # Old Fabric API shapes the 26.x host still serves under another name, and keys the runtime takes
# back from older shims, either to suppress them or to pin the handling that already works so
# every transform path agrees. Read by FabricApi26Rows.
# Every key uses the 26.x Mojang descriptor, because redirects match after the class remap.
# Kinds: C class rename, M method redirect, D redirect to a static helper that takes the receiver
# as its first argument, F field redirect, S suppress (the host keeps its own member and nothing
# host_from and host_to bound the hosts a row applies to; * means no upper bound. A host_to such as
# 26.1 names the whole line, 26.1.x included; a host_to such as 26.1.1 is exact.
# min_fabric_api is the oldest host Fabric API build that has the target, or - when the row needs
# none. call_site_owners lists subtypes a call site may name instead of old_owner, separated by
# Bump rows_version whenever a row changes, here or in a batch's own registration such as
# RenderRows, so jars translated with older rows are translated again. RowsVersionDigestTest
# fails when what the runtime registers changes and rows_version does not.
